reviews.title: They are fans, and they blow air.
reviews.comment: Got a HAVN case and need non-RGB fans to put behind a giant sensor screen? These are the ones. If you space that screen an inch away with spacers you get ample positive pressure that does not interrupt upwards air flow. The end result is one of the coldest cases I have ever seen.
reviews.author: Chris R.

reviews.title: great price, great airflow.
reviews.comment:
shockingly good for the money. one of the best bang for the buck fans on the market.
no... they wont be AS quiet as noctua, but they are so VERY close, that the premium for buying noctua fans at double or triple the price simply isnt worth it.
reviews.author: JP
